question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.order_id,
        c.customer_id,
        c.pizza_id,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.exclusions, ''), '') as excl_str,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.extras, ''), '') as extra_str,
        c.order_time,
        n.pizza_name,
        r.toppings as std_str
    FROM pizza_customer_orders c
    JOIN pizza_names n ON c.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes r ON c.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
    WHERE r.toppings IS NOT NULL
),
topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 1 as tid UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.pizza_id,
    o.pizza_name,
    o.order_time,
    o.std_str,
    o.excl_str,
    o.extra_str,
    ti.tid,
    -- Check if in standard
    CASE 
        WHEN o.std_str = '' THEN FALSE
        WHEN o.std_str = ti.tid::VARCHAR THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.std_str LIKE '%' || ti.tid || ',%' THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.std_str LIKE ti.tid || ',%' THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.std_str LIKE '%,' || ti.tid THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END as in_std,
    -- Check if excluded
    CASE 
        WHEN o.excl_str = '' THEN FALSE
        WHEN o.excl_str = ti.tid::VARCHAR THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.excl_str LIKE '%' || ti.tid || ',%' THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.excl_str LIKE ti.tid || ',%' THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.excl_str LIKE '%,' || ti.tid THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END as in_excl,
    -- Check if extra
    CASE 
        WHEN o.extra_str = '' THEN FALSE
        WHEN o.extra_str = ti.tid::VARCHAR THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.extra_str LIKE '%' || ti.tid || ',%' THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.extra_str LIKE ti.tid || ',%' THEN TRUE
        WHEN o.extra_str LIKE '%,' || ti.tid THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END as in_extra
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN topping_ids ti
ORDER BY o.order_id, ti.tid
